##### Project general facts

Luce is a magnificent building shaped by glass and light, embracing its seafront setting. This sublime building, composed of brilliant glass panels and oriented towards the sea and sunlight, becomes a showcase of captivating design. Offering a collection of brilliantly spacious apartments, Luce is where natural light, elegant materials, and breathtaking ocean views come together to create a living experience of unparalleled brilliance.

Direct beach access brings the resort-style atmosphere to your door, with a glistening infinity pool placed at the heart of a landscaped beachfront garden. Spend your days in this lush, natural setting, complete with a kids' pool, plunge pool, and jacuzzi. Every amenity is designed to create a lifestyle of relaxation and enjoyment, where the sea and sunlight become an integral part of everyday life.

The lustre of exquisite natural materials and interiors bathed in natural light define every residence at Luce. With a combination of soft lines and delicate tones, the luminescent interiors sparkle from sunrise to sunset. The sophisticated design aesthetic incorporates shades of white, earthy hues, and fine natural materials to create a polished and serene living environment that feels open and bright. Kitchens are fully equipped, and every room is filled with natural light, offering a sumptuous home of comfortable everyday moments.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the prestigious Palm Jumeirah, this exceptional location positions Luce on a seafront setting that embraces the natural beauty of the Arabian Gulf. The community is renowned for its stunning views, pristine beaches, and world-class amenities, making it Dubai's most celebrated destination.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to luxury hotels, resorts, and a range of retail and dining options. The iconic Atlantis, The Palm resort and its array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues are nearby, while recreational activities including water sports, beach clubs, and golf courses are within easy reach. The area's prestigious East Crescent setting offers residents a lifestyle of sophistication and exclusivity.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the brilliance of light, coastal elegance, and a prime Dubai address, Palm Jumeirah delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can experience the captivating design of glass and light.
